judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage aggregation across all tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and renames the `afterModelResponse` parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` just like the reference. All acceptance criteria are satisfied, including handling missing usage in intermediate or all rounds, preserving the existing no-tool test, and updating both `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`. It differs slightly from the reference by inlining the accumulation logic instead of extracting an `accumulateUsage` helper, placing the new spec bullets under the 'Measured semantics' section of `hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` rather than moving them to the main section and `hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and adding a separate acceptance test file alongside `.lore/dod.md`.
